meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把项目完整的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周拆成每周一个文件,再为每周顺序启动一个子代理写出一章叙事摘要,并生成逐周索引表和带序号前缀的章节文件。
howto.when: 当你要求「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」「serial timeline」等逐周连载章节,而不是单篇长报告时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into ISO weeks, then runs one subagent per week in sequence to write one narrative chapter per week, plus a weekly index.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story" or "serial timeline" — serial chapters rather than one long report.
